name: Grok Build Mode
desc: Describe an idea and Grok builds a working site, app or dashboard.
desc_zh: 在对话里描述一个想法，Grok 就做出可发布的网站、应用、游戏或看板。
solves: Turning an idea into something clickable used to need a project setup; the preview appears in the conversation and publishes to a link.
solves_zh: 把想法变成能点的东西原本要搭工程；现在预览直接长在对话里，还能发布成链接。
best_for: You want a small internal dashboard live this afternoon without opening a code editor.
best_for_zh: 想在今天下午就把一个小内部看板跑起来，又不想开代码编辑器时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — x.ai/news directory）。 Early Beta for SuperGrok Heavy subscribers on web, iOS and Android. This is a distinct capability inside Grok and is not the same product as Grok Build, the CLI coding agent already in the ledger. The homepage grok.com/build returns 403 to curl (bot guard) but its canonical URL is confirmed through the page reader. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Build Mode」，加上产品名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://x.ai/news/grok-build-mode 官网未直接确认（403）。
